content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Visakhapatnam Nurse Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Visakhapatnam Nurse Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Visakhapatnam Nurse Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Nurse post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Nurse post at HBCHRC Visakhapatnam is scheduled for 29th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue within the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Nurse position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a GNM with a Diploma in Oncology Nursing, or a B.Sc. Nursing, or an M.Sc. Nursing degree to be eligible for the Nurse post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Nurse post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Nurse position is 30 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Nurse role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Nurse post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 33,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Nurse post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the Nurse position at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the HRD Department, first floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, 530053.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their updated resume, recent passport-size photograph, photocopies of Pan Card and Aadhar card, original certificates, and one set of self-attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the Nurse post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the Nurse post. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for confirmation.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Nurse recruitment at HBCHRC Visakhapatnam will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
